title: DexStitch: Learning and Composing Dexterous Skills from Human Videos via Contact-Aware Robotic Inpainting
authors: Byeonggyeol Choi, Seongmin Jung, Unghui Nam, Youngbo Song, Sunhong Min, MinHyung Lee, Byonghyo Shim, Yongseok Lee

tldr.zh: DexStitch 从人类视频中提取操作技能及过渡示范，通过接触感知的人机转换训练共享扩散策略，以当前和下一技能指导衔接动作，并预测技能进度完成闭环切换，实现给定技能序列的连续执行。
tldr.en: DexStitch extracts manipulation skills and transition demonstrations from human videos, trains a shared diffusion policy through contact-aware human-to-robot conversion, conditions connecting motions on the current and next skills, and predicts skill progression for closed-loop switching through a given sequence.

evaluation_scope.zh: 逐指接触由 RGB 视频估计，同时约束手部重定向和合成画面的手指／物体遮挡。约 240 条长时序人类示范用于合成数据预训练，再混入约 32 条单技能真机示范微调；过渡示范仅来自人类视频。执行顺序由视频分类器或脚本给定，共享策略预测动作与技能进度，非自主任务规划。真机为 RB5-850E 臂＋xHand，实际执行 6 维臂关节及 12 维手关节动作。四项技能各测 5 次，单技能平均成功率 80%；10 次固定四技能序列中的 40 次技能执行平均成功率为 77.5%，不是整条序列全部成功的比例，未验证未见顺序泛化。画面合成采用拇指在前、其余接触指在后的包覆抓取假设。
evaluation_scope.en: RGB-estimated finger contacts guide both retargeting and finger/object occlusion in synthetic frames. Pretraining uses about 240 converted long-horizon human episodes; mixed fine-tuning adds about 32 single-skill robot demonstrations. Transitions are supervised only by human video. A video classifier or script supplies the order; the shared policy predicts actions and skill progression rather than autonomously planning tasks. Hardware is an RB5-850E arm with xHand, executing 6 arm and 12 hand joint commands. Four skills receive five isolated trials each, averaging 80% success. The 77.5% sequence metric averages 40 skill executions across ten fixed four-skill rollouts, not fully successful sequence rollouts. Unseen orderings are untested. Compositing assumes wrap grasps with the thumb in front and other contacting fingers behind the object.
